segments.name: Commercial vehicles
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, distributes and services electric and hydrogen-powered commercial vehicles for fleet and municipal organizations.
segments.evidence: We are an emerging designer, manufacturer, distributor, and service provider of commercial vehicles powered by either electricity or hydrogen energy sources.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling fully assembled commercial vehicles and unassembled semi-knockdown vehicle kits to fleet and municipal customers through dealers, EV Centers and channel partners.
revenueModel.evidence: we may distribute our vehicles in unassembled semi-knockdown vehicle kits ("vehicle kits") for local assembly in addition to fully assembled vehicles.

changes.text: In 2024 and 2025 the company shifted European distribution from Company-operated EV Centers to a distribution partner-led model.
changes.evidence: In European markets, where competitive and macroeconomic conditions warranted a more asset-light approach, the Company transitioned from Company-operated EV Centers to a distribution partner-led model, enabling greater operational flexibility and more efficient deployment of resources.

changes.text: In 2024 the company completed a redomiciliation changing its ultimate parent's jurisdiction of incorporation from Australia to Nevada.
changes.evidence: On February 27, 2024, our predecessor CEGL, a public company incorporated under the laws of Australia completed the Redomiciliation of CEGL.
